referenceFidelity.findings: Asymmetric gold and amber lobes with a warm trunk provide a seasonal variant without emission.

construction.findings: The first candidate had a slanted bottom cap 0.00613 m below zero. Flattened the trunk bottom in the source recipe; the replacement export is grounded. Reverse/underside confirm the fork enters the second lobe.

readability.findings: Personally inspected the phone-width and fixed-view renders: the crown outline and trunk remain readable; different forms are identifiable without relying only on color.

motion.findings: Static asset; no motion clips in the contract.

secondPass.findings: Rechecked the corrected ground contact and both crown attachments. The replacement has a flat bottom and a readable asymmetrical outline in close and phone views.

userAcceptance.note: New family delivered for user artistic review; no approval inferred.

limitations: Static environmental art; no collision, pathfinding or gameplay placement integration.
